validation.host_validation_source: GitHub Actions at the current pull-request head

device_gate.synthetic_route: ChatGPT ZIP -> safe archive adapter -> Wordbook -> 100-generation campaign

notes: Core uses Python standard-library SQLite, hashing, JSON, regex tokenization, zipfile, and optional SQLite FTS5.
Original evidence is not mutated by the 100-generation evolution campaign.
Meta-reference and quotation are separated from ordinary authored usage.
Host validation must be read from GitHub Actions at the current PR head; the manifest does not self-attest a mutable commit hash.
No Android/Termux validation is inferred from host tests or from merely preparing the device gate.
The device self-test uses a temporary synthetic ZIP and database so test language cannot contaminate the personal corpus.
No exhaustive account-wide language claim is valid until a complete corpus is imported and deduplicated.
The current JSON parser materializes conversations.json in memory; streaming import remains a future scalability gate.
